description: Stable vocabulary of semantic capabilities that prompts may provide. Every capability_id is addressable by PSC003; profile assignments must resolve here.

capabilities.title: Canonical Identity Preservation
capabilities.definition: Every executable representation preserves the canonical prompt's required obligations unless an explicit semantic migration authorizes replacement.
capabilities.evidence_requirements: Focused proof that compiledEffectivePrompts contain canonical copyContent verbatim or an explicit replacement-authorizing migration exists.

capabilities.title: Fresh Evidence Floor
capabilities.definition: Refresh repository and provider truth and reconcile branch-sensitive evidence before mutation or emitted commands.
capabilities.evidence_requirements: Repository evidence that git fetch and branch floor verification occurred before mutation.

capabilities.title: Bounded Scope Ownership
capabilities.definition: Bounded scope constrains writes without shrinking reasoning depth; shared owners and forbidden surfaces remain explicit.
capabilities.evidence_requirements: Sprint declaration declares owned and forbidden mutation surfaces and is enforced by validator.

capabilities.title: Fixed-Point Continuation
capabilities.definition: A first pass or first green is a checkpoint; continue while authorized progress-bearing work can materially reduce a required gap.
capabilities.evidence_requirements: Second-pass review evidence closing practical gaps before closeout.

capabilities.title: Parallel Dispatch
capabilities.definition: When graph width is at least two and safe capacity exists, independent lanes are actually launched concurrently and rejoined.
capabilities.evidence_requirements: Dispatch manifest plus observed_parallelism receipt for width>=2 lanes.

capabilities.title: Capability Ladder
capabilities.definition: Failure of one worker adapter class does not imply global absence; continue through the evidenced adapter ladder before degradation.
capabilities.evidence_requirements: Evidence that all adapter rungs were probed before reporting DEGRADED.

capabilities.title: Lane Isolation
capabilities.definition: Concurrent writers own isolated branches, worktrees, or workspaces and non-Git shared resources are serialized or separately allocated.
capabilities.evidence_requirements: Worktree/branch ownership proof for concurrent writers.

capabilities.title: Mainline Convergence
capabilities.definition: A green owned branch or PR is intermediate evidence; integrate into the refreshed default branch when all merge gates are satisfied.
capabilities.evidence_requirements: Exact validated head merged into default branch with containment proof.
